$note: Documented, versioned source of truth for this project's recommended MCP servers. Mirrored into the root .mcp.json, which is the file Claude Code actually loads — see README.md in this directory for why both files exist and how to keep them in sync.

postgres.$rationale: Read-only (--access-mode=restricted) schema/query introspection against the dev database, from crystaldba/postgres-mcp. Restricted mode runs everything in a read-only transaction and rejects statements that try to escape it. Used to verify module table ownership (CLAUDE.md §2.2) and inspect the executions/outbox tables during dispatch/reliability work — never to run migrations or writes. Requires 'uv'/'uvx' installed locally; DATABASE_URI must be exported in the shell that launches Claude Code.

prisma.$rationale: Official, Prisma-hosted remote MCP server for schema/migration assistance and Prisma Studio access. Authenticates interactively via Prisma Console on first use — no token is stored in this repo. Not available in unattended/headless runs until that first interactive auth has happened once per machine.
